text: On 24 March 1989 the Exxon Valdez, a tanker of Exxon Shipping Company, ran aground on Bligh Reef off Alaska and spilled about 11 million gallons of crude oil.

source.name: Supreme Court of the United States: Exxon Shipping Co. v. Baker, 554 U.S. 471, opinion of the Court (text via Cornell LII)
source.quote: the supertanker Exxon Valdez grounded on Bligh Reef off the Alaskan coast, fracturing its hull and spilling millions of gallons of crude oil into Prince William Sound

additionalSources.name: Exxon Valdez Oil Spill Trustee Council: Oil Spill Facts, Questions and Answers (undated page, read September 2026)
additionalSources.quote: the ship ran aground on Bligh Reef at 12:04 am March 24, 1989
